style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="140" y="1490" width="90" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u4Q4rLEWzoj9ohD987P4-155" value="<div><font color="#009900"><span style="font-size: 18px;"><br></span></font></div><ul><li><span style="font-size: 18px;"><font color="#009900">Add the difference to the bit[8]. So, bit[8] = 19 + 2 = 21.</font></span></li><li><span style="font-size: 18px;"><font color="#009900">index = index + index &amp; -index = 8 + 8 = 16.</font></span><br></li></ul>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="185" y="1540" width="500" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u4Q4rLEWzoj9ohD987P4-156" value="<span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">Now, 16 is out of range. So, no further iterations.</span>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="260" y="2220" width="410" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="u4Q4rLEWzoj9ohD987P4-157" value="<font color="#0000cc"><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">The main idea behind using the '</span><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;">index += index &amp; -index' formula is&nbsp;</span></font><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#0000cc">to traverse all nodes which are at the same level and under the same parent.</font></span><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#0000cc"><br></font></span></div><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#0000cc">Then, directly move to the first level and traverse parent nodes only in the&nbsp;</font></span></div><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#0000cc">next subtree&nbsp;</font></span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 204); background-color: initial; font-size: 18px;">as if you will update the parent, the whole subtree will be affected.</span></div></div><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#0000cc"><br></font></span></div><div><span style="font-size: 18px; background-color: initial;"><font color="#cc0000">Here, we will move from 3 to 4 (node at first level), and then 8.</font></span></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="149" y="-370" width="650" height="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
